grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Present progressive, first person plural
grammarPoints.rule: Use 'are' plus a verb ending in -ing to say what a group of people (including you) is doing right now. Contract 'we are' to 'we're.'

intro_examples.text: What are you doing? We're writing a story.
intro_examples.jp: 何をしていますか？私たちは物語を書いています。

table.title: Spelling the -ing form
notes: Add -ing to most verbs: count → counting, color → coloring, read → reading, talk → talking.
Drop the silent e before adding -ing: write → writing, erase → erasing, glue → gluing, use → using.
Double the final consonant for short verbs like cut → cutting, run → running, sit → sitting.

rules.title: Drop the silent e before -ing

rules.subtitle: Verbs that end in a silent e drop the e before adding -ing: write, erase, glue, use.
rules.jp_subtitle: サイレントe（発音しないe）で終わる動詞は、eを消してから -ing をつけます（write, erase, glue, use など）。

rules.jp_subtitle: 母音1つ＋子音1つで終わる短い動詞は、最後の子音を重ねてから -ing をつけます（cut, run, sit など）。

rules.title: Use 'we're' for yourself and others together

grammarPoints.subject: english
grammarPoints.title: Questions with Are there...? and short answers
grammarPoints.rule: Ask about things in a place with 'Are there any + plural noun...?' for more than one thing, or 'Is there a/an + singular noun...?' for one thing. Answer with short answers: 'Yes, there are/is.' or 'No, there aren't/isn't.'
grammarPoints.pattern: Are there any + plural noun...? / Is there a/an + singular noun...?

table.title: Are there / Is there — questions and answers
notes: Use 'Are there' with plural nouns and 'Is there' with singular or noncount nouns.
Short answers don't repeat the noun: 'Yes, there are.' not 'Yes, there are markers.'
Use 'any' in questions about plural or noncount nouns; use 'a/an' for one countable thing.

rules.title: Use 'Are there any' for plural nouns
rules.jp_title: 複数形の名詞には 'Are there any' を使う
rules.subtitle: Use 'Are there any' plus a plural noun to ask if more than one of something exists.
rules.jp_subtitle: 何かが複数あるかどうかを尋ねるときは、'Are there any' の後に複数形の名詞を続けます。

rules.title: Use 'Is there a/an' for one thing
rules.jp_title: 1つのものには 'Is there a/an' を使う
rules.subtitle: Use 'Is there a/an' plus a singular noun to ask about exactly one thing.
rules.jp_subtitle: ちょうど1つのものについて尋ねるときは、'Is there a/an' の後に単数形の名詞を続けます。

rules.title: Give short answers without repeating the noun
rules.jp_title: 名詞を繰り返さずに短く答える
rules.subtitle: Answer with 'Yes, there are/is.' or 'No, there aren't/isn't.' — don't repeat the noun in the short answer.
rules.jp_subtitle: 'Yes, there are/is.' または 'No, there aren't/isn't.' と答えます。短い答えでは名詞を繰り返しません。

rules.title: Match are/aren't with plural and is/isn't with singular
rules.jp_title: 複数形には are/aren't、単数形には is/isn't を合わせる
rules.subtitle: Keep the verb form the same in the question and the short answer: plural uses are/aren't, singular or noncount uses is/isn't.
rules.jp_subtitle: 質問と短い答えで動詞の形を揃えます。複数形は are/aren't、単数形や数えられない名詞は is/isn't を使います。
